editorial_workflow.subtitle: Identify → copy → edit → check
editorial_workflow.message: A new filename is not a backup plan.
editorial_workflow.description: Identify and keep the original, create a separate working copy with a clear name, and confirm that copy is the file you open. Export to a new file and listen to the result before removing anything. A second file on the same device is not an independent backup.
